name: Runemaster audit: Mystical Etchings cuts Fire/Nature/Frost/Arcane damage taken 15% at rank 2 (#3657)
contract: Mystical Etchings rank 2 (807921) has one effect, SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_TAKEN (87), EffectMiscValue 92 (Fire 4 + Nature 8 + Frost 16 + Arcane 64), EffectBasePoints -16 + DieSides 1 = -15%. It is native, implemented in Unit::MeleeDamageBonus/Unit::SpellDamageBonus, so a Frost-school probe (Frostbolt 116, school mask 16, a subset of 92) should drop 15% once 807921 is learned, while a Holy-school probe (Smite 585, school mask 2, outside 92) stays unaffected.

steps.label: Frost damage taken drops 15% (Frostbolt, school mask 16 subset of 92)
NEGATIVE CONTROL: Holy damage taken is unaffected (Smite, school mask 2, outside 92)
